issues.description: Field de.tum.cit.ase.Farm.animals visibility mismatch: The problem statement UML specifies the Farm attribute 'animals' as a private aggregation ("- animals: List<Animal>") and the textual instructions ask students to provide a getter and a setter for the animals list. In contrast, the solution repository declares the field as public ("public List<Animal> animals;"). This discrepancy can confuse students whether they should access the list directly or use accessors and contradicts the UML and the instructional guidance to implement getters/setters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Farm.animals field private to match the UML and the textual instruction (e.g., change to "private List<Animal> animals;"). Ensure the template and solution both declare the field as private and rely on the provided getAnimals()/setAnimals() methods. Update any internal uses in the solution to access the list via the getter/setter or via private access within the class (not public access), so students are not encouraged to access the field directly.
